detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #27 Network Drift Packet timing can change throughout a session. PH4NTXM's Network Drift uses netem to vary delay, jitter, and loss on qualifying Linux/Windows default-route interfaces. Profiles update every 20–59 seconds, with separate caps for wireless jitter and loss. Small duplication and reordering settings are also applied. Recognized tunnel, container, bridge, loopback, and ghost interfaces are skipped. This feature deliberately changes network behavior, so latency and throughput tradeoffs are real. Lonewolf does not apply this local shaping. Ιts network path follows Tor. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
